titlestmt.titleproper: A Guide to the Rockefeller Foundation records, Photographs, Series 100-1000 FA003
titlestmt.author: Bethany Francis

profiledesc.creation: This finding aid was produced using ArchivesSpace on 2026-09-18 10:33:42 UTC.
profiledesc.langusage: Description is written in: English, Latin script.

accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Open for research with select materials restricted as noted. Brittle or damaged items are available at the discretion of RAC.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: This collection is entirely made up photographs which document the activities of the Rockefeller Foundation during the years 1905-1980.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: The Rockefeller Foundation photographs are arranged in series primarily by country or state and then further arranged by subject/topic.

userestrict.head: Conditions Governing Use
userestrict.p: Rockefeller Foundation has title, copyright, and literary rights in the collection, in so far as it holds them. Rockefeller Archive Center has authority to grant permission to cite and publish archival material from the collection.

processinfo.head: Processing Information
processinfo.p: The Rockefeller Archive Center recognizes that our archival collections may contain problematic language and/or content.

Captions to many of these photographs and the staging of the photographs reflect the photographers' dehumanizing attitudes toward the people in the photos as subjects to be studied rather than an opportunity to mutually respect and learn from each other.

did.unittitle: Instruments for ultra microspectrographic quantitative cytochemistry

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: From the Rockefeller Foundation's Photograph Accession Log, Binder #6, Accession Number 22849: "Title: Photos received with list of publications from the Inst. covering period of RF grant #49030."

Torbjorn Caspersson sent Gerard Pomerat a December 9, 1953, report entitled, "Survey of the present state of the work on quantitative cytochemical procedures at the Institute for Cell Research, Medical Nobel Institute, Karolinska Institutet, Stockholm." Caspersson indicated in his covering letter of December 8, 1953, that he was also enclosing a list of reprints and seventeen figures. In addition to photographs of the equipment, the figures include graphs and images of research results.
